jobs.title: Technical Product Manager- Worksite Technology
jobs.description:
The Team
The Worksite Technology team is expanding its investment in digital capabilities and platform modernization. You will work alongside engineers, architects, product owners, and vendor partners to transform the current ecosystem into a cloud-first, API-driven, event-enabled architecture.
This team is responsible for building and operating platforms that support Worksite products, with a strong focus on customer experience, resilience, and scalability.

The Impact
As a Technical Product Manager, you will play a critical role in delivering reliable, high-performing technology solutions that support business growth and operational excellence.
Technical Product Ownership
- Own the technical product vision, roadmap, and backlog, aligning business objectives with scalable technology solutions
- Translate business requirements into architecture-aligned designs and executable delivery plans
- Drive prioritization across features, defects, and technical improvements

Engineering Delivery & Leadership
- Lead cross-functional teams (engineering, QA, analysts) to deliver high-quality, predictable outcomes
- Drive Agile execution, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release coordination
- Participate in solution design, architecture reviews, and technical decision-making

DevOps, Stability & Incident Management
- Act as the technical owner for platform stability and production operations
- Lead incident triage, major incident management, root cause analysis, and resolution planning
- Ensure systems meet availability, performance, and reliability targets
- Drive enhancements in monitoring, observability, and operational processes

Vendor & Partner Management
- Serve as the primary technical interface to vendors
- Enforce SLAs, delivery quality, and engineering standards compliance
- Ensure operational readiness, including support models, documentation, and incident processes
- Conduct vendor reviews and drive continuous improvement

System Design & Integration
- Drive delivery of microservices-based, API-first, and event-driven solutions
- Oversee integrations using Kafka, APIs, and Managed File Transfer (MFT)
- Guide implementation of batch processing, scheduling, and rules engines (OpenL)
- Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture and cloud strategy

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement
- Drive adoption of CI/CD pipelines, automation, and DevOps practices
- Ensure readiness for production deployment, release validation, and post-release stabilization
- Improve system performance, deployment frequency, and release quality

Stakeholder Collaboration
- Partner with business leaders, architecture teams, operations, and vendors
- Communicate technical tradeoffs, risks, and delivery status clearly and proactively
- Provide transparent reporting and proactive risk mitigation

The Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related technical field (or equivalent experience)
- 8+ years of experience in technical product management, software engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering
- 8+ years of experience leading end-to-end delivery of enterprise applications in Agile environments
- 8+ years of experience working with cloud-native and distributed systems architectures

The Ideal Qualifications
- Strong background in production support, incident management, and vendor-hosted platforms
- Proven ability to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions
- Strong communication, ownership mindset, and execution discipline
- Strong hands-on knowledge of: - Java, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture
- Event-driven systems and Kafka streaming
- API design and integration patterns (REST, async messaging)
- Frontend frameworks (React)
- Rules engines (OpenL)
- Batch processing and scheduling tools (Cron or equivalent)
- Managed File Transfer (MFT)
- AWS cloud services and cloud-native architectures

- Experience with: - CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tooling, and observability frameworks
- Vendor-led delivery models and SLA governance
- Financial Services, Insurance or regulated industry platforms
- Supporting supplemental/worksite insurance products

- Ability to: - Lead technical design discussions and influence architecture decisions
- Balance product priorities with technical constraints and operational needs
- Operate effectively in fast-paced, complex enterprise environments
- Drive continuous improvement in system reliability and delivery practices

What You Can Expect at MassMutual
MassMutual offers the opportunity to do meaningful work within a purpose-driven organization that values long-term impact over short-term outcomes. In this role, you can expect:
- Clear areas of ownership and accountability, with work that connects directly to company and customer outcomes
- A collaborative environment where perspectives are welcomed
- Access to learning, development, and internal networks that support continuous growth and skill-building over time
- Employee-led communities and forums that foster connection, learning, and inclusion across the organization
- A culture grounded in integrity, responsibility, and stewardship—supported by a company with a strong legacy and a future-focused mindset

jobs.title: Product Owner- Workflow Orchestration
jobs.description:
Product Owner- Workflow Orchestration
Shared Services & Enablement
Full-time, Springfield, MA

The Opportunity
As the Product Owner- Workflow Orchestration, you will create the strategy, determine the business goals, formulate scope and develop a roadmap for the implementation of the Salesforce customer relationship management (CRM) platform and other large-scale strategic MassMutual initiatives intended to transform how we deliver service to our advisors and customers for years ahead.
In this role, you will partner with all levels of leadership and cross-enterprise parties (e.g. Operational areas, MMLIS, ETX, Legal, Compliance, Human Resources, etc.) on the execution of the advisor and customer engagement strategy.

The Team
As a key member of the Shared Services & Enablement Team—a highly collaborative group that drives engagement strategy across the enterprise—the Product Owner will shape the long‑term vision for how MassMutual equips its advisors and delivers service to customers. This role blends strategic thinking, cross‑functional leadership, product planning, and operational alignment to ensure that large‑scale initiatives deliver meaningful, future‑ready capabilities that elevate the overall service experience.

The Impact
This role defines and prioritizes product features that meet current and future customer and advisor needs. It partners across business areas—Operations, ETX, vendors, and subject matter experts—to deliver tools that optimize technology, improve service interactions, and drive business value. The position leads prioritization, scope, and timing of Salesforce deliverables; develops business requirements aligned to strategic outcomes; removes obstacles; evaluates risks; and makes key decisions that guide project direction and timelines. It also ensures each business area is operationally ready for transitions with minimal service impact.
Success in this role requires strong project leadership, data analysis, business knowledge, agility, resilience, and consistent stakeholder communication to maintain transparency on strategy, status, decisions, and challenges throughout the multi-phase effort.

The Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree or 10+ years equivalent work experience in business consulting or project management in lieu of degree

The Ideal Qualifications
- Strong data analysis with experience managing complex and multiple data resources
- Able to provide insight and recommendations based on data analysis
- Financial acumen with experience in tracking and reporting benefit realization
- Knowledge of systems, processes and workflows within operations
- Excellent project management skills
- Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to effectively present complex information clearly
- Extremely organized, detail-oriented individual, who is capable of self-managing and multi-tasking in a fast-paced, demanding environment.
- Ability to work independently with minimal direction and potential ambiguous situations
- Demonstrated ability to adapt to changing business priorities and a strong work ethic

- Ability to successfully manage work with current and sometimes competing priorities

jobs.title: Product Management and Pricing Actuary
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
We are seeking a highly engaged Pricing Actuary to join a dynamic team environment for Life Pricing & Profitability. This individual will be organized, detail-oriented and excited to take accountability and ownership for their work.
As a member of the Life Insurance Pricing and Profitability team, you will partner with the Underwriting and Medical teams to evaluate new and existing underwriting programs. You will also monitor key profitability and business metrics and pricing assumptions, taking a holistic approach to assessing emerging experience across the life insurance portfolio. This role offers the opportunity to influence a product line that is critical to the company’s success.

The Team
The Life Pricing team is responsible for the pricing and profitability of MassMutual’s retail life insurance products. The team is comprised of a group of actuaries and quantitative analysts with extensive experience in life insurance pricing, product development, and modeling. The team is focused on meeting the needs of three key stakeholders – our policyholders, our distribution partners, and our company.

The Impact:
Underwriting Functions
- Represent Pricing and Product Management in the oversight and analysis of the accelerated underwriting program. Partner with internal stakeholders to develop analytics, communicate results, and influence future program enhancements.
- Monitor the MassExpress fluidless underwriting program, including mortality slippage, pass rates, and other key performance indicators, and partner with Underwriting on regular program oversight.
- Partner with New Business, Underwriting and Medical teams to assist in developing and assessing the protective value of key underwriting programs.
- Analyze underwriting performance and other portfolio-level risk indicators to identify emerging trends and support profitability objectives and risk management decisions.

Profitability and Emerging Experience Analytics
- Evaluate large and complex life insurance cases for alignment with profitability guidelines and the company’s risk appetite and provide analysis to support placement and capacity decisions.
- Perform analyses using VNB, IRR, profit margin, and other profitability metrics to support underwriting and business decisions.
- Perform sensitivity testing and scenario analysis to assess the impact of key assumptions, emerging risks, and business trends on profitability.
- Develop Power BI dashboards, presentations, and recurring reports that communicate profitability, new business performance, rider utilization, and emerging experience to facilitate management reporting.
- Analyze rider utilization and profitability to identify emerging trends, risks, and opportunities.
- Support the development, aggregation, validation, and communication of quarterly VNB reporting.
- Monitor, analyze and report on key business KPIs, providing insights to support strategic decision-making.

Product Design and Pricing
- Support life insurance product pricing by helping to develop assumptions for new products and maintaining clear documentation of final pricing decisions and assumptions.
- Provide ad hoc actuarial analysis and support for pricing, profitability, and product initiatives.

The Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field
- ASA designation
- 5+ years of actuarial experience in pricing, experience studies or related actuarial functions.
- 1+ years of experience working with life insurance products
- 2+ years of experience actuarial models

The Ideal Qualifications
- FSA Designation
- Experience with accelerated underwriting programs a plus
- Experience with using Power BI, experience studies and data management a plus
- Life insurance pricing experience, along with exposure to coding/programming are a plus
- Ability to interact with technical and non-technical audiences at all levels, within and across organizational boundaries
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills: ability to document complex issues, methodologies, and resolutions such that others can readily understand them
- Ability to use a disciplined work approach to initiatives, projects, and day-to-day activities
- Ability to work cross-functionally to reconcile competing priorities while meeting organizational objectives
- Sound business judgment in an environment of rapid change, and the ability to respond to changes in direction, tight deadlines, and high-pressure situations
- Comfortable dealing with both complexity and ambiguity, and able to explore multiple solutions to a problem
- Takes ownership and is results-orientated

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Product Development & Technology
jobs.description:
Business Analyst, Product Development & Technology
Insurance, Worksite, & Institutional Technology
Full Time – Springfield/Boston

The Opportunity
As a Business Analyst, you will shape the systems requirements and solution approaches that bring new and enhanced insurance products to market. Your work will connect business strategy with technology execution, helping ensure complex product development programs deliver effective, scalable solutions for customers and the business.

In this highly collaborative and fast-paced role, you will partner with Product, Operations, Architecture, Engineering, Quality Assurance, and Delivery teams to translate business objectives into clear, actionable requirements and solution definitions. You will provide senior business systems analysis leadership, independently guide decisions, resolve ambiguity, and drive alignment across stakeholders to support successful delivery from concept through implementation.

The Team
The Insurance, Worksite, & Institutional Technology organization supports the capabilities used to design, launch, and service Life, Annuity, Disability, and related insurance products. The team spans policy administration, underwriting, illustrations, product rules, integrations, digital experiences, correspondence, reporting, and downstream operations. In this role, you will strengthen requirements practices and solution readiness across these capabilities to improve alignment and reduce rework.

The Impact
- Lead requirements strategy for complex, cross-functional insurance product initiatives, ensuring business objectives are translated into clear, actionable system requirements.

- Elicit, document, decompose, validate, and prioritize business and functional requirements to improve solution clarity and delivery readiness.

- Partner with business and technology stakeholders to shape solution approaches, evaluate impacts and dependencies, and guide informed decisions.

- Maintain requirements traceability across design, development, testing, implementation, and post-launch support to help ensure intended business outcomes are achieved.

- Facilitate working sessions, resolve ambiguity, and drive alignment across teams to reduce delivery risk and downstream rework.

- Apply insurance domain knowledge and systems thinking to identify gaps, support quality validation, and strengthen solutions throughout the product lifecycle.

The Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's Degree
- 8+ years of experience in Business Analysis, Business Systems Analysis, Product Analysis, Systems Analysis, or a related technology delivery role.
- 3+ years of experience supporting insurance operations and technology initiatives in areas such as Life, Annuity, Disability, Underwriting, Policy Administration, Billing, Claims, or related insurance functions.

The Ideal Qualifications
- 10+ years of progressive Business Analysis or Business Systems Analysis experience, including experience leading analysts or serving as the lead analyst on major programs.
- 3+ years of experience leading requirements for complex systems, integrations, vendor platforms, or cross-functional technology initiatives.
- 5+ years of experience supporting multiple phases of the software delivery lifecycle, including requirements, design, development, testing, implementation, and production support.
- 5+ years of experience developing business analysis deliverables such as requirements, functional specifications, user stories, process flows, data requirements, and acceptance criteria.
- 3+ years of experience facilitating requirements and solution design sessions and documenting key decisions, issues, and action items.
- 3+ years of experience preparing and presenting requirements, recommendations, and project updates to senior leaders and stakeholders.

- Advanced knowledge of insurance product development, including product specifications, state filing considerations, regulatory impacts, and launch readiness.

- Experience working across Agile, hybrid, and waterfall delivery models, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, PI planning, release planning, and structured governance.

- Experience with one or more insurance technology capabilities, including policy administration, underwriting, illustrations, product or rules engines, data integrations, correspondence, reporting, or advisor- and customer-facing digital platforms.

- Experience coordinating delivery with third-party vendors, managed service partners, or enterprise shared service teams.

- Proficiency with analysis and delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, Visio, Miro, Excel, PowerPoint, SQL, or comparable tools.

- Professional certification such as CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, CSPO, SAFe, Six Sigma, or a comparable credential.
